chapter: Decca records, the Savoy and Moe Gale
title: Savoy stays, Gale bookings and Don Redman billing
summary: The band alternated weeks in and out of the Savoy, was booked by Gale in theatres and nearby territory, and played Christmas dates billed as Redman's.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How long were you there, two weeks.

We'd go in there on two weeks and out two, I think on that trip, we stayed there three weeks. I think we were there three weeks that trip and was out for a week, come back in for two and were out for two weeks and come back in for two. That's the way they used to do it. They had their bands.
The house bands and things like that, and then Gail had bands.
Did he book you out of New York after that.

Yes. He booked us down in the theatres and different places, upstate, you know, and Jersey and up through that territory, and in fact, that was the first time that we did some dates, that was the first time we did some dates with what's his name, Don.
We went again, we went up there and did a lot of

Christmas dates without even doing the Christmas and things like that up there and it was billed as Don Redman's band. But later on as things rocked on, Gail sent us on a southern tour and so this particular --
